summary: Six-phase plan (5.5h) adding --dream as an 8th /distill sub-mode, scoped entirely to agent-system/extensions/memory/. Phase 1 wires command-layer dispatch in distill.md. Phases 2-4 author the SKILL.md `### Sub-Mode: dream` section: event ingestion via events-query.sh only (with the no-events degraded path), two-tier event-to-memory correlation and corroborated/contradicted/gap classification, revision through the existing UPDATE/tombstone/CREATE primitives behind a mandatory AskUserQuestion stop, then the separate improvement-proposal deliverable, dream-log.json schema, state integration, and --auto exclusion. Phase 5 syncs distill-usage.md/EXTENSION.md/index-entries.json and verifies manifest.json needs no change. Phase 6 verifies cross-table consistency, doc-lint, no new task-number citations, and that agent-system/extensions/core/ is untouched. All research design decisions carried verbatim; the three decisions research left open are ratified in the plan. Verified live during planning rather than assumed: specs/events.jsonl is absent and events-query.sh returns total_events:0 / [] at exit 0, so the no-events path is the DEFAULT day-one experience and is planned as first-class, not an edge case; and the deployed .claude/commands/distill.md is byte-identical to source (diff -q clean), confirming deployed copies are pure sync targets and correctly out of scope.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase implementation plan, 5.5 hours, 5 dependency waves. Phases 1 and 2 run parallel (distinct files); 2->3->4 are strictly sequential on the shared SKILL.md dream section; 5 depends on 1+4; 6 is verification-only.

next_action_hint: Run /implement 872 to execute the plan. Three things the implementer must get right: (1) do NOT copy the adjacent `Available (task 450)` cells when adding new sub-mode table rows -- those are pre-existing no-task-references-in-deliverables violations and must not be extended, though fixing the existing ones is out of scope; (2) manifest.json is expected to need NO change -- 'verified, no change required' is the correct and complete outcome, not a reason to manufacture an edit; (3) the no-events path is a normal documented outcome with a visible notice, never an error branch. Research's three open decisions are now ratified in the plan: state field is last_dream/dream_count; the narrative dream report is terminal-only with no persisted dream-report-{date}.md (dream-log.json is the machine record); and the multi-task-creation-standard.md compliance-table row is a deliberate documented follow-up since that file lies outside the declared memory-extension scope.
